project_info.theme: cinematic monochrome electric-guitar editorial surrounded by pigeons
project_info.color_palette: black, white, gray, and muted metallic highlights

main_subject.description: An adult woman with long light-blonde hair blowing in the wind, natural skin texture, and an intense upward gaze directly into the lens.
main_subject.wardrobe: Minimal black distressed clothing with textured fabric and no visible branding.
main_subject.pose: Standing or kneeling on textured outdoor ground while actively playing a black electric guitar.

composition_elements.framing: High-angle near bird's-eye composition with the adult guitarist centered and one pigeon crossing the extreme foreground for depth.
composition_elements.environment: Dry grass, scattered feathers, and open sky tones around a dynamic flock of pigeons in flight; no text or logos.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp eyes and guitar details with motion blur on wings and layered foreground depth.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Hard natural daylight with deep shadows, bright cloud separation, and crisp highlights on hair and guitar hardware.

technical_specs.camera: High-angle full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, f/5.6, 1/500 s, ISO 200
technical_specs.quality: Analog black-and-white film character, textured grain, sharp subject detail, realistic guitar materials, and natural wing motion blur

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic 4:3 black-and-white analog music editorial photograph of an adult woman with long light-blonde hair blowing in the wind, natural skin texture, and an intense upward gaze directly into the lens. She wears minimal black distressed clothing with no branding and actively plays a black electric guitar. Use a high-angle near bird's-eye composition with her centered on textured outdoor ground, dry grass and scattered feathers around her, and a dynamic flock of pigeons in flight. Place one pigeon in the extreme foreground for depth, with motion blur on wings and sharp focus on her eyes and guitar. Use hard natural daylight, deep shadows, bright cloud separation, film grain, and a gritty metal-album-cover atmosphere with no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, over-smooth skin, deformed guitar, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original subject. Optional guitar, wardrobe, environment, or bird-motion references may replace only their named element while preserving the high-angle composition, monochrome film treatment, dynamic flock, and gritty music mood.

assets.name: black-electric-guitar
assets.usage: Replace only the guitar body, hardware, and finish while preserving playable proportions and removing logos.

assets.name: minimal-black-distressed-music-look
assets.usage: Replace only the adult subject's distressed black clothing without adding revealing styling or branding.

assets.name: dry-grass-open-sky-ground
assets.usage: Replace only the outdoor ground texture, sky, and feather details.

assets.name: pigeons-in-flight-motion-reference
assets.usage: Replace only the flock density, wing motion, and foreground bird depth.
